notes: Alternate baseline/candidate order across paired forks.
Use 95% bootstrap intervals and report dispersion; overlapping/inconclusive evidence is not a proven gain.
Reject unexplained material low-contention or complete-path regressions; do not weaken thresholds after seeing candidate data.
JFR attribution is separate from scored throughput/latency.
Representative Java 17/25 and Java 21/25 virtual-thread comparisons are separate profiles.
The first Redis smoke run used interval 64. Scored runs share the corrected interval-31 harness on both runtimes to avoid mixed-cycle sampling aliasing.

summary.method: paired fork means; medians and descriptive paired geometric-mean bootstrap interval; 10000 draws; fixed seed; n=3, not a universal significance claim

lowConcurrencyDiagnosticPlan.purpose: Diagnose short-window low-concurrency p99; original scored results and criteria remain unchanged.

interruptedPair.reason: Investigator stopped the active JMH launcher after completing Redis comparisons: the one-thread L2 p99 exceeded the declared guardrail and requires diagnosis.
interruptedPair.interpretation: Interrupted measurement, not a library correctness failure and not a scored performance sample.
